commerce.title: Commercial systems
commerce.problem: When sales and customer service use separate information, every order means piecing the context back together.
commerce.solution: I connect orders, customers and availability so sales and follow-up can work from the same system.
commerce.result: Less duplicate work and better-informed customer service.
commerce.examples: A point of sale linked to inventory; a customer ordering portal.

operations.title: Management and operations
operations.problem: Scattered spreadsheets and informal handovers make it hard to see what is pending and who needs to act.
operations.solution: I design management tools with clear states, responsibilities and traceable processes.
operations.result: A clearer view of operations and better coordination.
operations.examples: Inventory across locations; delivery planning and tracking.

applications.title: Web and mobile applications
applications.problem: Work does not always happen at a desk: customers and teams need access from different devices.
applications.solution: I build web and mobile experiences around each person’s tasks, connected to the central operation.
applications.result: Information and actions available where they are needed.
applications.examples: A field application; a customer self-service portal.

automation.title: Automation and integrations
automation.problem: Copying data between tools takes time and can leave conflicting versions of the same operation.
automation.solution: I integrate systems and automate tasks with explicit rules, traceability and error handling.
automation.result: More consistent workflows with less manual intervention.
automation.examples: Generating documents from orders; synchronizing sales and management systems.

intelligence.title: Data and artificial intelligence
intelligence.problem: Collecting data is not enough without a useful way to interpret it, make decisions or answer questions.
intelligence.solution: I organize information, build indicators and introduce AI assistance where the problem and available data support it.
intelligence.result: Evidence-based decisions and assistance with clear boundaries.
intelligence.examples: An operations dashboard; an assistant that queries business information.

process.collaboration: You provide context and validate decisions. I design, implement, test and document the solution, and support its launch within the agreed scope. Pace and next steps are defined for each project.

understand.title: Understand
understand.work: Explore the operation, the problem, constraints and objectives before proposing a solution.
understand.deliverable: A shared summary of the problem, objectives and points that need confirmation.
understand.client: Share context, processes and constraints; confirm that the problem has been understood.
understand.professional: Listen, analyze and organize findings and open questions.

define.title: Define
define.work: Agree on scope and priorities, design the experience and explain technical decisions.
define.deliverable: An agreed scope, priorities and acceptance criteria to guide implementation.
define.client: Prioritize needs and validate scope, experience and business decisions.
define.professional: Propose options, explain trade-offs and design a feasible solution.

build.title: Build and validate
build.work: Implement in increments and assess each delivery through testing and review.
build.deliverable: Reviewable increments, test evidence and a record of agreed adjustments.
build.client: Review progress and give feedback on how it fits the operation.
build.professional: Implement, test, fix issues and communicate progress and limitations.

evolve.title: Deliver and evolve
evolve.work: Prepare documentation and deployment, define useful metrics and agree on continued support.
evolve.deliverable: The agreed solution and documentation, with launch criteria and next steps.
evolve.client: Validate delivery, coordinate adoption and prioritize future improvements.
evolve.professional: Document, support deployment and propose improvements within the agreed scope.
